summary.intent: Generate and verify a complete documentation suite for the cipher-box monorepo using the GSD docs-update workflow, then ship it via PR. A follow-up health check fixed planning directory integrity issues.
summary.outcome: Shipped PR #482 with 29 files (+2683/-477): 10 new/regenerated canonical docs, 6 corrected existing specs, 12 per-package READMEs. PR #483 then fixed planning health (invalid config value, missing VALIDATION.md, 5 non-canonical files relocated). Health check now reports 0 errors, 0 warnings.

repo: packages/crypto/src/ was renamed to packages/core/src/ — METADATA_SCHEMAS.md and METADATA_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md had 15+ stale path references to the old location
folder.service.ts no longer exists; folder depth enforcement lives in apps/web/src/hooks/useFolderMutations.ts (createFolder at :102, moveFolder at :283)
TEE republish interval is 6 hours (REPUBLISH_INTERVAL_HOURS=6 in republish.service.ts), not 3 hours as CAPACITY.md claimed in three places
crates/core/src/file.rs is an 11-line re-export shim; FileMetadata and VersionEntry are actually defined in crates/core/src/folder.rs
recovery.html accepts hex-only private keys for v2 recovery; base64 is explicitly rejected at line 1102, and v1 inline-file recovery is unsupported (logs error and skips)
docker/docker-compose.yml has 5 services including an undocumented someguy delegated-routing service (port 8190 routing API, 4004 libp2p) and mock-ipns-routing (loopback 3001)
TEE worker simulator defaults to port 3001, conflicting with mock-ipns-routing; workaround is PORT=3002 when running both
folder_ipns table has IDX_folder_ipns_user_id on user_id and unique constraint on (user_id, ipns_name); no owner_public_key column exists

8 load test scenario files use checkThresholds (not 5 as CAPACITY.md claimed): ipns-publish-storm, spike-test, sustained-load, sdk-folder-read, mixed-workload, upload-throughput, sdk-upload-pipeline, sdk-ipns-contention
apps/api/src/migrations/ contains 16 files; DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md only listed 14 (missing AddSignedRecordToFolderIpns and AddPublicKeyToFolderIpns)
someguy's 8190 routing API is published locally but internal-only in staging docker-compose.staging.yml
planning config.json had model_profile set to 'adaptive' which is invalid; valid values are quality/balanced/budget/inherit

code.finding: TypeORM synchronize/migrations/migrationsRun config (was incorrectly documented as lines 85-87)
FileMetadata struct (file.rs is only a re-export shim; fixer initially pointed at wrong file)
VersionEntry struct (same re-export issue as FileMetadata)
Vendored fuser source with FUSE-T socket patch lives here, not in crates/fuse which is a regular Cargo dependency
Hex-only restriction for v2 private key input; base64 explicitly unsupported
v1 format not supported — logs error and continues (skips item)
publicKey length check is 64 (Ed25519, not 130 for secp256k1 as METADATA_SCHEMAS claimed)

workflow: GSD commit helper (gsd_run query commit) can report false commit_failed due to lint-staged spinner output in stdout; always verify success via git log rather than trusting the helper's exit signal
When parallel background agents auto-recover from transient API errors, stop any manually-respawned duplicates immediately (TaskStop) before the original finishes and overwrites the completed file
Background agents killed by process exit lose in-flight state; check on-disk file existence before assuming work was lost and re-dispatching
Markdownlint MD040 (code fences missing language tag) must be fixed before commit; lint-staged enforces this in the repo

Deeper re-verification passes can surface claims the first pass missed (e.g., METADATA_SCHEMAS line ranges); the 2-iteration fix-loop cap means residual issues after iteration 2 require manual inline edits

friction: Two Wave-1 agents hit transient API errors (socket closed, stream idle timeout) after 55-74 tool calls, requiring manual respawns and TaskStop race management
A Claude Code process exit mid-session killed all 5 iteration-2 fix agents simultaneously; their partial edits had to be inferred from on-disk state and applied manually
TaskStop returned errors for the two orphaned Wave-1 respawns (they had already been killed by the process restart, not by TaskStop)

METADATA_SCHEMAS required the most fix iterations: the iteration-2 automated fixer introduced new Rust line-range errors by using the re-export file.rs instead of the actual folder.rs, requiring a third manual pass with verifier-confirmed line numbers
GSD commit helper false-negative on the ship-record commit caused unnecessary uncertainty about whether the commit landed
